answer: Make every agent lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and let peers slash that stake when they prove a fake identity. One fake account costs real money, and ten thousand fakes cost ten thousand stakes, so the loss sends a ripple through the attacker's budget before any profit arrives. Honest agents pass a velvet rope that only opens for the verified, and each proven attestation is signed with a quill of cryptographic proof no forger can mass-produce.
